moments.author: Is Lebron A 76er Yet
moments.quote: ‘No. He never will be now. Time to deactivate’ — subtweet reboot with GIF after LeBron signs with Sixers
moments.why: An 8‑year dormant fan account revived with perfect timing, producing what fans call ‘the greatest sports tweet of all time,’ racking up 54M views and 1M likes

moments.author: LeBron James
moments.quote: “This is my last decision… I still want to compete, to win… another championship.”
moments.why: LeBron framing his move to the 76ers as his final NBA choice reignited discussion across sports and culture

moments.author: Unverified user quoted Shams Charania
moments.quote: “BREAKING: LeBron James is signing with the Philadelphia 76ers on a two‑year, $8 million deal with a player option.”
moments.why: Charania’s breaking news tweet sparked a wildfire reaction as fans realized LeBron wasn’t choosing Miami or Golden State

moments.author: Merriam‑Webster
moments.quote: Merriam‑Webster cheekily tweeted the definition of “the process” after LeBron signs with Sixers
moments.why: Classic brand meme moment: redefining a famed Sixers slogan amid LeBron news, perfect blend of pop culture and social media humor

moments.author: VJ Edgecombe
moments.quote: Posted Instagram Story recreating LeBron’s pool meme: “Smiling through it all! Can’t believe this is my life.”
moments.why: A teammate’s hilarious, genuine reaction made waves, humanizing the news and giving fans a laugh
